en.title: Full Stack Software Developer
en.summary: Full stack software developer with experience building web and mobile applications with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Flutter. Experience designing serverless architectures on AWS and integrating generative AI into support and automation workflows. Currently maintaining, testing and developing features for a social platform used on Android, iOS and Web.

bullets: Maintain a live social platform for creators, brands and artists across Android, iOS and Web.
Perform QA testing of new features and regression checks before each release.
Develop new features across the Flutter application and the Firebase backend.
Resolve issues and deliver fixes through pull requests and code review.
experience.stack: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Cloud Functions, Stripe

bullets: Led, together with the team, the full-stack migration of SAP services for five business areas, keeping operations running while adapting each service to its needs.
Developed and refined OData services and SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications, reducing data overhead and keeping the code clean and maintainable.
Diagnosed and resolved incidents in SAP features and services, validating results with functional tests before production release.

React, Next.js, Vue, HTML, CSS, Sass, Tailwind CSS
Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase, Supabase, OpenSearch

es.title: Desarrollador de Software Full Stack
es.summary: Desarrollador de software full stack con experiencia en aplicaciones web y móviles con JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js y Flutter. Experiencia diseñando arquitecturas serverless en AWS e integrando IA generativa en flujos de soporte y automatización. Actualmente realiza mantenimiento, pruebas y desarrollo de funcionalidades en una plataforma social disponible en Android, iOS y Web.

bullets: Mantenimiento de una plataforma social en producción para creadores, marcas y artistas en Android, iOS y Web.
QA testing de nuevas funcionalidades y pruebas de regresión antes de cada entrega.
Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades en la aplicación Flutter y el backend en Firebase.
Resolución de issues y entrega de correcciones mediante pull requests y revisión de código.
